safety.text: When the caller is not the owner, withdraw/redeem must check and decrease the owner's allowance to the caller before moving funds.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.
evidence: In a standard ERC4626 implementation, if the caller (`msg.sender`) is not the owner of the shares (`owner`), the vault must check and decrease the allowance that the owner has granted to the caller (`allowance[owner][msg.sender]`).
